title: A stuck click burns the whole test and fails as 'Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded' instead of naming the locator
symptoms: The error log ends with waiting for getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }) rather than a locator timeout
expect assertions fail after 5 s while actions wait 30 s
cause: Actions and navigations have no timeout of their own by default, so they wait until the 30 s test timeout ends the test. Assertions use a separate 5 s expect timeout.
fix: Set actionTimeout and navigationTimeout below the test timeout so a missing element fails fast with its own error.
